title: Disappear
subtitle: 「消失／不見／逐漸淡去／不復存在」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「消失／不見／逐漸淡去／不復存在」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 比 disappear 更常帶突然、完全消失的感覺。
words.example: The bird vanished into the trees.

exercises.original: The bird disappeared suddenly into the trees.
exercises.zh: 那隻鳥突然消失在樹林中。

options.explanation: 突然、完全看不見，最合適。
表示逐漸變弱，不適合突然飛入樹林。
也接近，但只描述離開視線，少了突然感。

exercises.original: The magician made the coin disappear completely.
exercises.zh: 魔術師讓硬幣完全消失。

options.explanation: 魔術語境中「完全不見」非常典型。
通常用於霧、煙、熱等散開。
表示被藏起，並非真正消失。
make + object 後需要原形動詞。

exercises.original: The car disappeared around the corner in seconds.
exercises.zh: 汽車幾秒內就在轉角後消失不見。

options.explanation: 快速而突然離開視線，最自然。
語義很接近，但較中性描述視線結果。
實體汽車不會逐漸變淡。

words.note: 表示聲音、光、記憶或感覺慢慢變弱直到消失。
words.example: The sound of the music faded away.

exercises.original: The music gradually disappeared as the train moved farther away.
exercises.zh: 火車愈駛愈遠，音樂聲逐漸消失。

options.explanation: 聲音逐漸變弱至聽不見。
較技術化，日常聲音不如 fade away 自然。
偏活動或談話逐步停止。

exercises.original: Her memory of the event slowly disappeared over the years.
exercises.zh: 多年來，她對這件事的記憶慢慢淡去。

options.explanation: 記憶逐漸變弱是典型用法。
較常用於機會、時間、人離去。

exercises.original: The light slowly disappeared as evening came.
exercises.zh: 隨著夜晚來臨，光線逐漸淡去。

options.explanation: 句子需要有限動詞過去式。

words.note: 常用於顏色、光線、記憶、感情等逐漸減弱。
words.example: The colours faded in the sunlight.
words.exampleZh: 顏色在陽光下逐漸褪去。

exercises.original: The bright colours disappeared gradually after years in direct sunlight.
exercises.zh: 鮮艷顏色在多年陽光直射後逐漸褪去。

exercises.original: The old photograph gradually lost its colour intensity.
exercises.zh: 舊照片的色彩強度逐漸變淡。

options.explanation: 照片本身沒有突然消失。

exercises.original: Her excitement disappeared gradually after several disappointing results.
exercises.zh: 幾次令人失望的結果後，她的興奮感逐漸消退。

options.explanation: 也可形容情緒/緊張，但較正式。
不常用於短期個人情緒。

words.note: 正式而明確，表示存在本身完全終止。
words.example: Several villages ceased to exist after the flood.
words.exampleZh: 洪水後幾個村莊不復存在。

exercises.original: Several small villages disappeared completely after the flood.
exercises.zh: 洪水後幾個小村莊完全不復存在。

options.explanation: 表示村莊本身不再存在。
可能只表示看不見，語義較弱。

exercises.original: The organization disappeared as a legal entity after the merger.
exercises.zh: 合併後，該組織作為法律實體不復存在。

options.explanation: 法律身份正式終止，最精確。

exercises.original: The old system disappeared completely when the new law took effect.
exercises.zh: 新法律生效後，舊制度完全不復存在。

options.explanation: 較口語且通常逐步停止。
只表示下降，不是完全消失。

words.note: 常用於物種、語言、傳統、習俗等逐代消失。
words.example: The tradition may die out within a generation.
words.exampleZh: 這項傳統可能在一代內消失。

exercises.original: The old tradition may disappear within a generation if young people stop practising it.
exercises.zh: 若年輕人停止實踐，這項傳統可能在一代內消失。

options.explanation: 也可比喻，但更像記憶/聲音淡去。

exercises.original: Several local dialects are disappearing as fewer children learn them.
exercises.zh: 愈來愈少兒童學習，幾種本地方言正逐漸消失。

exercises.original: Some species disappear naturally when they can no longer reproduce successfully.
exercises.zh: 一些物種在無法成功繁殖時會自然滅絕。

words.note: 常用於霧、煙、熱、緊張等逐漸散開。
words.example: The fog began to dissipate after sunrise.

exercises.original: The fog slowly disappeared after sunrise.
exercises.zh: 日出後，霧慢慢消散。

options.explanation: 霧散開、變薄並消失最精確。
也可，但偏視覺逐漸變淡。
物理上相關但日常語境不如 dissipate。

exercises.original: The tension in the room disappeared once the misunderstanding was explained.
exercises.zh: 誤會解釋清楚後，房間裡的緊張氣氛消散了。

exercises.original: The smoke disappeared into the air within a few minutes.
exercises.zh: 煙在幾分鐘內逐漸散入空氣。

options.explanation: smoke spreading and thinning 最合適。

words.note: 本義是液體蒸發；比喻時常指希望、資金、機會迅速消失。
words.example: Their hopes of winning quickly evaporated.
words.exampleZh: 他們取勝的希望很快消失。

exercises.original: Their hopes of winning disappeared quickly after the second goal.
exercises.zh: 第二個入球後，他們取勝的希望很快消失。

options.explanation: hope + rapid disappearance 是常見比喻。

exercises.original: The money seemed to disappear almost immediately after the project began.
exercises.zh: 項目開始後，資金似乎很快消失無蹤。

options.explanation: seemed to 後用原形，且比喻資金快速消失自然。
表示逐步減少，不合 almost immediately。

exercises.original: The early optimism disappeared once the real costs became clear.
exercises.zh: 實際成本清楚後，最初的樂觀情緒便消失。

options.explanation: 抽象希望/樂觀突然消失很自然。
較像活動或興趣逐步停止。

words.note: 只表示從視野中消失，不代表停止存在。
words.example: The boat went out of sight behind the island.
words.exampleZh: 小船駛到島後，離開了視線。

exercises.original: The boat disappeared behind the island but continued sailing.
exercises.zh: 小船駛到島後看不見了，但仍繼續航行。

options.explanation: 句子明說仍在航行，所以只是離開視線。

exercises.original: The runner disappeared around the bend.
exercises.zh: 跑手轉過彎後離開視線。

options.explanation: 只是被彎位遮擋，最精確。

exercises.original: The aircraft disappeared into the clouds but remained visible on radar.
exercises.zh: 飛機進入雲層後肉眼看不見，但雷達仍可追蹤。

options.explanation: 仍可雷達追蹤，證明只是肉眼不可見。

words.meaning: 悄然離開；不知不覺流失
words.note: 常用於人悄悄離開，以及時間、機會逐漸失去。
words.example: The opportunity slipped away before they could act.
words.exampleZh: 他們還未行動，機會便悄然消失。

exercises.original: The opportunity disappeared before they could make a decision.
exercises.zh: 他們還未作決定，機會便悄然消失。

options.explanation: opportunity + missed chance 是典型搭配。

exercises.original: The afternoon disappeared while we were talking.
exercises.zh: 我們談話時，下午時間不知不覺地流逝了。

options.explanation: 時間悄然流逝非常自然。

exercises.original: He quietly disappeared from the party without saying goodbye.
exercises.zh: 他沒有道別便悄悄離開派對。

options.explanation: quietly + leaving unnoticed 正是此義。
表示躲起來，不等於離開。

words.note: 強調數量、資源、支持等從多到少。
words.exampleZh: 他們的積蓄慢慢減少至所剩無幾。

exercises.original: Their savings gradually disappeared over several months.
exercises.zh: 他們的積蓄在數月間逐漸減少至幾乎沒有。

exercises.original: Support for the plan disappeared little by little.
exercises.zh: 對計劃的支持逐步減少，最後所剩無幾。

options.explanation: 把 support 當作數量逐步減少，最貼切。
也接近，但偏活動/動能停止。
本身可成立，但少了 away 的「近乎消失殆盡」感。

exercises.original: The supply of clean water gradually disappeared during the drought.
exercises.zh: 乾旱期間，潔淨食水供應逐漸減少。

options.explanation: supply 是可逐步減少的資源量。
水本身可蒸發，但句子談的是 supply。

words.note: 較口語，常用於談話、活動、掌聲、興趣等逐步停止。
words.exampleZh: 談話慢慢變少，最後停了。

exercises.original: The conversation gradually disappeared as everyone became tired.
exercises.zh: 大家累了之後，談話逐漸變少並停止。

options.explanation: conversation 慢慢減弱並停止是典型用法。
也能理解，但更常配聲音/光/記憶。

exercises.original: The applause slowly disappeared after a few minutes.
exercises.zh: 幾分鐘後，掌聲逐漸減弱並停止。

options.explanation: 也可配聲音，但 peter out 更強調活動停止。

exercises.original: Interest in the project gradually disappeared once funding was cut.
exercises.zh: 資金削減後，大家對項目的興趣逐漸減退直至消失。

options.explanation: 也合理，但更偏感受逐漸變弱。

falseSynonyms.zh: 離開 ≠ 消失 一個人可以離開，但仍然存在，也可能仍看得到。
躲起來 ≠ 消失 hide 表示仍然存在，只是不讓別人看到。
失去 ≠ 消失 lose something 表示你找不到它，不代表東西本身真的 disappeared。
移走 ≠ 自己消失 remove 通常有外力主動把某物移走。
摧毀 ≠ 消失 destroy 表示被破壞；disappear 可以完全沒有破壞。
下降 ≠ 消失 decline 只是變少或變弱，未必降至零。
詞性陷阱 disappear = 動詞；disappearance = 名詞；disappearing = 現在分詞／形容詞。
詞形不同 vanish = 原形；vanished = 過去式／分詞；vanishing = 現在分詞／形容詞。
